android-navigation|NavigationRail.summary: A Plenix navigation rail on Android is Material 3’s navigation rail, used for the top-level destinations of a multi-area app on medium windows and up (600 dp and wider) in place of the navigation bar, kept native in behavior (one destination always selected, ripple, TalkBack, font scaling, the start inset) and styled with the Plenix tokens: the raised surface with a 1 dp line along its end edge, destinations at the top, 24 dp icons with DM Sans labels always shown, and the current destination in the Plenix selected colors. Material’s default is a surface rail with a secondary-container indicator; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.
